objective: Find an introduced async error-handling regression and avoid unrelated style comments.

input.task: Review this change against the requirement that failed payments remain retryable.

artifacts.fact: The change removes await from persistFailure(paymentId) inside try/catch, so a rejection escapes after retry state is reported saved.

must_include: P1 or P2 severity with rationale

graders.criterion: The finding explains why try/catch no longer observes the rejection and how behavior violates the requirement.
The output follows the finding contract and remains read-only.

origin.failure_mode: Reviewer misses an introduced asynchronous failure path or fills the review with noise.
